LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.Ui.Help.OutpostAttackPoin:
Vanilla raid points are calculated from the colony's current situation, then converted into outpost attack points.

Examples (base conversion):
100 raid points → 12 outpost attack points
1000 raid points → 27 outpost attack points
10000 raid points → 58 outpost attack points

Actual outpost attack points vary randomly between 80% and 120% of the base value.
